Jet.FailureTrail

`Trail (N calls passed it up, origin first):` followed by one numbered `{fn_name} ({file}:{line})` line per hop, each with its note after an em dash and `×N` when the same hop repeats, and under it the hop's trimmed source line.

What

`Trail (N calls passed it up, origin first):` followed by one numbered `{fn_name} ({file}:{line})` line per hop, each with its note after an em dash and `×N` when the same hop repeats, and under it the hop's trimmed source line.

Why

Each call that passes a failure up joins the failure's trail, so the report can show where the failure started and which callers forwarded it.

Fix

Read the root failure above the trail first — it says what went wrong. Then read the trail from hop 1, the origin, down to the last hop at the entry.

Worked example
